text: The second season of ABC reality television series The Bachelor premiered on September 25, 2002, featuring 28-year-old Aaron Buerge, a banker from Butler, Missouri. The season ended on November 20, 2002, with Buerge proposing to 27-year-old school psychologist Helene Eksterowicz; they ended their engagement weeks after the finale. The bachelorettes for this season included Heather Cranford, who returned for the sixth season of The Bachelor and also competed in season four, placing 9th/12th after being eliminated the week she arrived, and Mary Delgado, who placed 9th/11th in the first season of Bachelor Pad. There were no dates during the first week. Three group dates occurred, with five women sent on each. One group date included Angela, Christi from Idaho, Gwen, Hayley, Heather from California, Heather from Texas, Kyla, and Shannon. One-on-one dates were held for Helene, Brooke, Gwen, and Heather from Texas. A group date also took place involving Angela, Brooke, and Hayley. Hometown visits were held in Kansas City, Missouri (Angela), Gloucester, New Jersey (Helene), Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (Gwen), and Albertville, Alabama (Brooke). Overnight dates were shared by Brooke, Gwen, and Helene. The final dates were with Brooke and Helene, including meetings with Aaron's parents.
